spots.name: Kadıköy İskelesi (Eminönü–Karaköy, yeni iskele)
spots.coordSource: OSM way/560203763 (building=transportation, building:levels=2), area centroid, re-fetched from Overpass 2026-09-22 data (0.5 m from claim)
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 82.4 x 18.0 m (1,478 m²), re-computed. The long axis runs 123/303°, perpendicular to the Rıhtım quay, so the bar reaches about 80 m out to sea towards 303°. Slight waist mid-length (sides 28.7 + 53.6 m). Two storeys (OSM). Height estimated at about 10-11 m to the eaves and 13 m to the roof. The landward entrance faces 123° towards Rıhtım Cd and Haldun Taner.
spots.look: Built 1982. Renovated Oct 2005 to Mar 2008: the exterior was re-clad to suit Ottoman architecture and the floors laid in travertine (Hürriyet). Denizhaber adds that the load-bearing frame was kept and the new cladding is precast panels. The facade is a light panel system with arched openings in a regular rhythm. Ground floor: passenger hall. The building also holds a cafeteria, seminar rooms and an art gallery. Berths run along both long sides and at the seaward head, with fenders, bollards and a gangway pontoon. Colours and roof form are in no source: use light cream panels and a dark grey metal roof, and check against a photo. No source mentions a clock tower.
spots.nightLighting: Assumed: warm interior glow through the arched openings, a lit blue Şehir Hatları name board on the sea end, pole lamps along the berth edges, and the lit café. No documented facade floodlighting.
spots.infoTr: Eminönü ve Karaköy vapurlarının kalktığı, kıyıdan denize doğru uzanan iskele binası 1982'de yapıldı. 2005–2008'deki yenilemede cephesi Osmanlı mimarisine uygun biçimde yeniden kaplandı; binada yolcu salonunun yanı sıra kafe, seminer salonları ve sanat galerisi bulunur.
spots.correction: Info text simplified: dropped the 'taşıyıcı sistemi korunarak / prekast panel' detail. It comes from a single source (Denizhaber) and could not be re-verified; Hürriyet confirms only the Ottoman-style facade and the travertine floors. The use list was also aligned with Hürriyet.
spots.overlaps: Repo pier 'kadikoy' (src/world/life/data/places.ts), berth [40.99296, 29.02313], sits on this building. pier-builder.ts draws a generic 2-storey cream hall parallel to the shore, with a gable roof and a clock tower. The real building is an 82 x 18 m bar perpendicular to the shore. Keep the builder's platform, fenders and lamps, skip its hall and clock tower at this berth, and place the hero model instead.

spots.name: Tarihi Kadıköy İskelesi (Beşiktaş iskelesi, İBB Kadıköy İskele Kütüphanesi)
spots.coordSource: OSM way/102190096 ('Kadıköy (Beşiktaş) İskelesi', building=transportation, building:levels=2), area centroid, re-fetched (0.3 m); ferry node 583523020 at 40.99182, 29.02155
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 36.7 x 16.7 m (522 m²; the İBB library uses 480 m²). The long axis runs 65/245°, parallel to the shore. The sea facade faces about 334° and the land facade about 154°, towards Rıhtım Meydanı. Shallow projections of 1.5-3.5 m for the stair bays and end pavilions. Two storeys. Height estimated at about 10 m to the eaves and 13 m to the hipped-roof ridge. Each of the two removed onion domes would add about 3-4 m (estimated).
spots.look: Built 1926 in the First National Architecture style; MİMDAP calls it neo-classical. The architect is unknown: MİMDAP and Muşazlıoğlu say it was not built to Vedat Tek's design. Symmetrical two-storey facade. The sea side has three arched doors on the lower level, and further arched doors and small arched windows are arranged symmetrically. Kütahya tile panels are set into the rendered walls, under a hipped roof (kırma çatı). Two onion domes originally stood over the two staircases on the sea facade; they were removed in the first repair of 1959, so the building has no domes today (optional period variant). Later repairs: 1984-86 and 1995, plus a glazed turnstile booth on the land side. Restored by İBB in 2022-23 and reopened on 26 Apr 2023 as the İBB Kadıköy İskele Library and Vapur Kafe, still working as a pier. Wall colour is not stated: use light render with blue/turquoise tile bands and a dark grey roof, and verify with a photo.
spots.nightLighting: Assumed: warm library and café light through the arched windows, a blue Şehir Hatları sign on the sea face, and lamp posts on the pier apron. No documented facade floodlighting.
spots.infoTr: Deniz doldurularak genişletilen kıyıya 1926'da yapılan, Birinci Ulusal Mimarlık üslubundaki iki katlı iskele binası; kemerli pencereleri ve çini panolarıyla tanınır, deniz cephesindeki iki soğan kubbe 1959 onarımında kaldırıldı. 2023'ten beri vapur iskelesi olarak çalışırken İBB Kadıköy İskele Kütüphanesi'ne de ev sahipliği yapıyor.
spots.correction: 'Sivri kemerli' was softened to 'kemerli' in the info text: MİMDAP describes arched doors and windows but not specifically pointed arches. The architect is given as unknown, because the Kültür Envanteri attribution to Vedat Tek is contradicted by two local sources.
spots.overlaps: Second berth of repo pier 'kadikoy' ([40.99182, 29.02155] = OSM ferry node 583523020). Replace the generic 'kadikoy' hall and clock tower here with the hero building. It lies about 150 m SW of the new pier and about 560 m SW of landmark 'haydarpasa-gari'; no conflict.

spots.name: Kadıköy Boğa Heykeli (Altıyol)
spots.coordSource: OSM node/2892392880 'Boğa Heykeli' (historic=memorial), re-fetched, exact. Island ring = OSM way/694950207 (15.0 x 14.9 m, lit=yes); square = OSM way/285574893 'Altıyol Meydanı' (44 x 40 m, 433 m²)
spots.dimensions: Life-size bull; no published measurements. Estimates: bull about 2.5-2.8 m nose to rump and 1.5-1.7 m at the withers, on a bronze ground slab of about 3.0 x 1.2 m. Stone pedestal about 1.3-2 m (estimated). Total height about 3.0-3.5 m. It sits in a round cobbled island 15 m across (OSM, re-computed) with small grass patches, inside the paved Altıyol Meydanı (about 44 x 40 m). The T3 tram track passes about 11 m away.
spots.look: Charging bull in dark bronze: head lowered, horns forward, heavy neck and shoulders, front legs braced, anatomically male. Brown-black patina with green tones; the areas people touch may be polished lighter (unverified). The slab carries Isidore Bonheur's signature and 1864. It sits on a plain grey stone pedestal (form not described in sources) in the centre of the six-road junction: Söğütlüçeşme Cd, Bahariye/General Asım Gündüz Cd, Kuşdili Cd and others. From the air it is tiny: make it readable through the round island, a x1.3-1.5 scale-up and the discovery marker. İBB Miras carried out repairs in Apr-May 2022 and short maintenance on 8 Apr 2026. Heading 280 (towards Söğütlüçeşme Cd and the pier) is NOT sourced; the second researcher assumed 200. Verify against a photo before modelling.
spots.nightLighting: Square and ring are lit (OSM lit=yes). No documented dedicated floodlight. Suggest 2-3 warm ground uplights on the pedestal so the bronze reads as a silhouette with warm rim highlights, inside the bright glow of the surrounding shopfronts.
spots.infoTr: 1864'te Paris'te dökülen, Fransız heykeltıraş Isidore Bonheur imzalı bronz boğa; İstanbul'a Sultan Abdülaziz döneminde mi, yoksa 1917'de II. Wilhelm'in Enver Paşa'ya hediyesi olarak mı geldiği tartışmalıdır. Saray bahçeleri ve Spor ve Sergi Sarayı önü gibi yerlerde durduktan sonra 1987'de Altıyol'a konuldu ve Kadıköy'ün en bilinen buluşma noktası oldu.
spots.correction: Merged the duplicates from researchers 1 and 2. They disagreed on heading (280 vs 200) and on priority (must vs should); neither heading has a source. Kept 280 as provisional and listed it as an open question. Kept 'must', because the bull is the most-cited symbol of Kadıköy and the round island is readable from low altitude. Added the year (1917) to the Wilhelm/Enver version per tarihi.ist.
spots.overlaps: None in landmarks.ts. Keep the procedural road and tram generator from drawing lanes through the 15 m island.

spots.name: Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadyumu (Chobani Stadyumu)
spots.coordSource: OSM way/66321024 (leisure=stadium, name 'Chobani Stadyumu', start_date=1907), area centroid, re-fetched (0.3 m); building relation 1735806
spots.dimensions: Outer footprint 200.7 x 163.7 m (31,663 m², re-computed), with its long axis at 334/154°, matching the pitch. Roof opening about 121 x 83 m (OSM inner ring way 178240485). Pitch 105 x 68 m. Roof 24,500 m², 160 m clear span, about 1,600 t of steel (ATAK Engineering). Height to the roof top is estimated at about 40 m; no source found. Capacity 47,430 (TFF, per tr.wiki) or 47,911 (en.wiki). 132 skyboxes. En.wiki mentions a planned 2026-27 modernisation to about 64,000 seats with a raised roof; per researcher 3 it was announced 9 Sep 2026 and awaits permits. Model the current bowl.
spots.look: A tight, steep rectangular bowl with rounded corners: four enclosed two-tier stands with no running track. A continuous roof ring covers every seat: a light grey/white membrane on steel trusses, with a rectangular hole over the green pitch. Seats are in club yellow and navy blocks. The main-stand exterior is concrete with glazed skybox fronts. The Fenerium store building (OSM way 236464871, about 190 x 73 m) runs along the WSW long side. The FB TV building is to the north, and the Söğütlüçeşme Marmaray/metrobüs viaducts are about 200 m NE. It is the dominant mass of the Kuşdili valley from the air.
spots.nightLighting: On match nights: 1,400 lux LED pitch lighting, giving a brilliant white rectangle visible from far away. There are no floodlight masts in OSM, so the lights are expected on the inner roof edge (verify). Pre-match yellow/navy LED shows, and LED lighting on the Fenerium facade. Otherwise dim. The four lattice floodlight towers at 40.9836-40.9846, 29.0354-29.0361 belong to the Dereağzı training pitch, not the stadium.
spots.infoTr: 1908'de Papazın Çayırı'nda açılan sahanın yerinde yükselen, 1999–2006 arasında baştan yapılan, bütün tribünleri kapalı, yaklaşık 47 bin kişilik Fenerbahçe stadı; 2009 UEFA Kupası finaline ev sahipliği yaptı. 2025–26 sezonundan beri sponsor adıyla Chobani Stadyumu olarak da anılıyor.
spots.correction: Info text fixed. The old text said Fenerbahçe had played there since 1908, but the ground opened on 17 Sep 1908 as Papazın Çayırı / Union Club Field and became Fenerbahçe Stadium only in 1929 (en.wiki). The capacity figures from en.wiki and the TFF differ and are both noted.
spots.overlaps: None in landmarks.ts. The Kadıköy core layout will otherwise fill this plot with generic blocks, so exclude the footprint when the hero is placed.

spots.name: Kalamış–Fenerbahçe Marinası
spots.coordSource: Area-weighted centre of OSM way/242312415 (Setur Kalamış Marina, 138,020 m², centroid 40.97640, 29.03779) and way/236778445 (Setur Fenerbahçe Marina, 152,720 m², centroid 40.97209, 29.03607), re-fetched and re-computed. Breakwaters exist only as part of the OSM coastline (no man_made=breakwater ways, checked).
spots.dimensions: Two basins together about 1 km N-S. Kalamış basin (north) about 491 x 366 m; Fenerbahçe basin (south) about 525 x 392 m. Kalamış west breakwater about 320 m running NNW to its tip at 40.97705, 29.03547; north mole about 180 m to 40.97705, 29.03638; entrance about 77 m, opening north. Fenerbahçe west breakwater about 330 m straight N-S along lon 29.0338-29.0345, 20 m wide, tip at 40.97402, 29.03445. Cross mole about 150 m at lat 40.9739-40.9743; entrance about 78 m between the tips at 29.03445 and 29.03538. Breakwaters 20-35 m wide including the inner quay. Pontoons 30-250 m (OSM man_made=pier). Capacity 1,278 sea + 220 land berths (Setur); maximum LOA 65 m, depth 6.5 m.
spots.look: Rubble-mound breakwaters: grey rock armour on the sea side and a flat concrete crown/quay inside, about 3-4 m above water (estimated). Long grey floating pontoons run at right angles off the quays, packed with white hulls: a forest of aluminium masts (sailboats estimated at a third to a half), with larger motor yachts in the Fenerbahçe basin. Along Fener Kalamış Cd: low 1-2 storey marina buildings and restaurants, car parks and a hardstand with boats on cradles. Fuel dock near the Kalamış entrance (40.97691, 29.03648). Redevelopment: Koç/Tek-Art holds a 40-year concession. The ÇED was approved on 9 Jan 2026, with construction planned for up to 32 months: 2,120 berths, breakwater area 24,900 → 36,158 m², 1,555 m quay, 4,054 m of docks, dredging to -6.5 m. Some sources report the basins will be merged; the ÇED article does not say so. Model the current two-basin layout, optionally with a few work barges or cranes.
spots.nightLighting: Entrance lights (OSM seamarks, re-fetched): Kalamış Fl G 10 s at 40.97705, 29.03547 (E4909) and Fl R 10 s at 40.97705, 29.03638 (E4909.2); Fenerbahçe Fl G 10 s at 40.97402, 29.03445 (E4909.4) and Fl R 10 s at 40.97388, 29.03538 (E4909.6); researcher 3 reports the Fenerbahçe pair as Fl(2) per the NGA list. Also low bollard lights on the pontoons, quay lamp posts, scattered masthead lights, restaurant glow and water reflections.
spots.infoTr: Kalamış Koyu'nda 1987'de hizmete giren yat limanı Kalamış ve Fenerbahçe olmak üzere iki havzadan oluşur; denizde yaklaşık 1.280 tekne bağlanabilir. Ocak 2026'da ÇED onayı alan yenileme projesiyle kapasitenin 2.120 yata çıkarılması planlanıyor.
spots.correction: Info text changed from 'süren yenileme projesi' to 'Ocak 2026'da ÇED onayı alan yenileme projesi'. The ÇED approval is confirmed (emlaknews, 9 Jan 2026), but an actual construction start is not. The basin-merge claim is marked as reported, not confirmed.
spots.overlaps: No pier in places.ts and nothing in landmarks.ts. coastline.ts strips narrow (< ~30 m) marina features, and its BREAKWATERS list contains only the two Haydarpaşa moles. Add the Kalamış and Fenerbahçe breakwaters there (or have the hero builder supply them), or they will be lost. Lies in district 'fenerbahce'.

spots.name: Fenerbahçe Feneri
spots.coordSource: OSM way/236188307 (man_made=lighthouse, 14 m² outline), centroid, re-fetched (0.3 m); seamark light node 1579289377 'Fener Burnu' at 40.96817, 29.03201; compound OSM way/237302203 (32.5 x 30.7 m, centroid 40.96817, 29.03192)
spots.dimensions: Tower 20 m tall, focal height 25 m above sea (KEGM, the primary source; OSM seamark:light:height=25). En.wiki has the two numbers swapped. Tower about 4.2 m in diameter (OSM outline). It stands in the east half of a walled square compound of about 32 x 31 m (653 m²). The shoreline is 35-45 m to the west. Optics: 500 mm catadioptric cylindrical lens with a 1000 W lamp.
spots.look: Cylindrical masonry tower painted white, with two galleries (circular balconies with metal railings) and a glazed lantern on top. A one-storey masonry keeper's house is attached, inside the walled square courtyard. Railing and lantern-dome colour is unverified: assume dark metal and check photos. It stands on the low rocky west rim of the Fenerbahçe headland among the park's lawns and trees. The site is open to the public; the tower is closed. The white vertical at the tip of the green headland is the landmark from the air.
spots.nightLighting: White Fl(2), 12 s period: 1.5 s on, 2 s off, 1.5 s on, 7 s off (KEGM, and OSM sequence 1.5+(2)+1.5+(7)). Range 15 NM, focal height 25 m, E4910, ARLHS TUR-021. Öreke Taşı rock light about 230 m SW (40.96682, 29.02956): Fl(2) W 5 s, 5 m high, 3 NM (E4912, OSM-confirmed).
spots.infoTr: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman'ın 1562'de burada ışık yakılmasını buyurmasının ardından Fenerler İdaresi 1857'de bugünkü 20 metrelik beyaz kuleyi yaptırdı; semt adını bu fenerin bulunduğu bahçeden alır. Işığı 12 saniyede iki kez beyaz çakar ve 15 deniz mili uzaktan görülür.
spots.correction: Kept the KEGM heights (tower 20 m, focal 25 m); en.wiki swaps them. Added the 'Fener Bahçesi' name origin to the info text.
spots.overlaps: None in landmarks.ts or the piers. It sits at the west edge of Fenerbahçe Parkı, whose repo landuse polygon is misplaced (see fenerbahce-park).

spots.name: Tarihi Moda İskelesi
spots.coordSource: OSM way/132474437 ('Tarihi Moda İskelesi', building:levels=2, historic=building), centroid, re-fetched (0.3 m); jetty OSM way/53726665 (man_made=pier, 94.3 m)
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 14.1 x 11.5 m (160 m²), with edges at 45° and 135°. 400 m² gross on 2 floors (Arkitera). Height about 11-12 m to the roof ridge above the deck (estimated). Jetty 94.3 m (re-computed) in two legs: 41.6 m at 139° from the shore at the end of Moda Cd (40.97977, 29.02479) to a knee (40.97949, 29.02512), then 52.7 m at 172° to the building. Jetty about 5-6 m wide (estimated).
spots.look: A free-standing two-storey pavilion out in Moda bay on a bent concrete jetty on piles. Vedat Tek, 1916-17, First National Architecture; the exterior emphasises arches and columns (Arkitera). Imitation cut-stone render in light beige/grey with block joints. The facades differ: the long SE facade facing Fenerbahçe has five pointed arches; the shore side has three flattened 'Bursa arch' doors; a spiral stair on one side leads to the upper floor. Tile panels appear only on the window lintels. Hipped tiled roof (tile colour estimated red). The restored interior has a timber coffered ceiling, black steel roof carriers and deep-green tiles, visible at night. The jetty has railings and lamp posts. Moda Deniz Kulübü's boat piers are about 150-300 m west.
spots.nightLighting: Exterior lighting picks out the arches and columns. Library and café interiors glow warm through the arcades. A row of lamp posts runs along the jetty, with strong reflections on the water.
spots.infoTr: Mimar Vedat Tek'in tasarladığı, 1917'de tamamlanan iki katlı iskele binası; 1986'da seferler durduruldu, 2001'de yeniden iskele olarak açıldı. 2022'deki İBB restorasyonundan beri vapur iskelesinin yanı sıra kafe ve kütüphane olarak da kullanılıyor.
spots.correction: Info text now includes the 2001 reopening as a pier. The 2022 İBB reopening was on 19 Aug 2022. The date 1917 is kept; the facade inscription 1335 reads as 1916-17 (Hijri) or 1919 (Rumi).
spots.overlaps: No Moda pier in places.ts. Since 1 Jan 2024 it has been served by the Bostancı–Moda–Karaköy–Kabataş line (per search results), so a berth near 40.9789, 29.0253 could be added. The building needs its own hero model rather than the 'small' style.

spots.name: Haldun Taner Sahnesi (Eski Kadıköy Hal Binası)
spots.coordSource: OSM way/102190100 (amenity=theatre), area centroid, re-fetched (0.6 m)
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 2,144 m² (tr.wiki gives 1,833 m²). The long axis runs 64/244°, parallel to the quay, with a length of 63.4 m. The main block is about 29.8 m deep; the end pavilions project about 2 m (SE) and 4.9 m (NW), so the overall depth is 36.8 m. The central block of about 37.5 m sits between pavilions of 12.5-13.3 m. U-plan: two symmetrical two-storey wings around a former central courtyard under a glass roof. Two storeys, estimated 12-14 m. The restoration adds a basement.
spots.look: Former fruit and vegetable market hall. Umberto Ferrari's signature plaque was found under the plaster during the restoration. Designed 1925-27 in the First National Architecture style with Seljuk-inspired arches and tile decoration. Arkitera describes it as cherry-red (vişne çürüğü). Long symmetrical two-storey block with end pavilions, rows of arched windows, a glazed roof over the former courtyard and a hipped roof. It faces the sea and the pier forecourt, between the two pier buildings. Market until 1973, conservatory 1984-89, and a 286-seat theatre from 1989. Closed for restoration since 2021: the exterior walls and roof geometry are kept, and the new programme has 448 + 95 seats. No reopening confirmed as of Sep 2026; the April 2026 photos still show works.
spots.nightLighting: When open: warm floodlight on the red facade and lit arched windows. While under restoration: mostly dark with site lights.
spots.infoTr: İtalyan mimar Umberto Ferrari'nin tasarladığı, 1925–1927'de sebze-meyve hali olarak yapılan Birinci Ulusal Mimarlık yapısı; 1989'da avlusu İstanbul Şehir Tiyatroları'nın Haldun Taner Sahnesi'ne dönüştürüldü. Bina 2021'den beri restorasyonda.
spots.correction: Dimensions clarified: the minimum rectangle is 63.4 x 36.8 m including the pavilion projections, and the main block is 29.8 m deep. The new seat count is 448 + 95.
spots.overlaps: None in landmarks.ts. It sits between the two 'kadikoy' pier berths, so keep procedural buildings out of its OSM footprint.

spots.name: Sultan III. Mustafa (İskele) Camii
spots.coordSource: OSM way/102190093 'Sultan Mustafa İskele Camii' (building=mosque), area centroid, re-fetched (0.4 m)
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 35.1 x 22.1 m (601 m², including the portico/annex; the prayer hall is square). Axes 119/299° and 29/209°. headingDeg follows the repo convention (the axis nearest the qibla). Walls 1.30 m thick (MİMDAP). Dome about 15 m high (single unverified source). Minaret estimated at about 30-35 m.
spots.look: Square-plan classical mosque in cut stone with a single lead dome on an octagonal drum. The side walls have three windows each, the middle one higher, with stained-glass flower motifs above. Last-congregation portico with three arched doors. One single-balcony cut-stone minaret stands between two buildings. Has a şadırvan. Built on the shoreline and raised 1.5-2 m above the sea; land reclamation now leaves it on Yasa Cd / Tavus Sk at the market edge, facing the pier square and the İskele Camii tram stop. Warm grey-beige stone and a dark lead-grey dome.
spots.nightLighting: Assumed: typical İstanbul mosque floodlighting, a warm-white wash on the dome and minaret and a lit balcony ring. A mahya is unlikely on a single minaret.
spots.infoTr: III. Mustafa'nın 1761'de hassa başmimarı Mehmed Tahir Ağa'ya yaptırdığı kare planlı, tek kubbeli cami; yapıldığında deniz kıyısındaydı ve adını iskeleye yakınlığından alır. 1853 yangınında hasar gördü, 1858'de Abdülmecid döneminde onarıldı.
spots.overlaps: Not in landmarks.ts. If the generic mosque pass already emits OSM building=mosque, register it only once.

spots.name: Süreyya Operası
spots.coordSource: OSM way/491935728 (amenity=theatre, building:levels=3), centroid, re-fetched (0.5 m)
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 1,307 m²: about 30.6 m of street front on Bahariye (west side) and 54.2 m deep eastwards, long axis 100/280°. Three levels (OSM). Facade estimated at 16-18 m and auditorium ridge at about 20 m. 570 seats; stage 14 x 10 m; 500-person ballroom on the upper floor.
spots.look: Sits in a continuous row of 5-7-storey apartments, so from the air it reads as one unbroken roof of about 31 x 54 m, level with or lower than its neighbours. The street facade is symmetric and flat, with an Art Deco foyer inspired by the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées. Light cream/ivory render (colour from photo memory; verify). Glazed ground-floor entrance doors under a flat canopy. Tall windows grouped on the central axis between flat pilasters. İhsan Özsoy's reliefs: two seated female figures at the entrance (lyre; quill and scroll), children playing ancient instruments, and four portrait medallions with instruments under the eaves. Strong cornice. No dome; metal roof covering since the 2006-07 restoration (tone estimated).
spots.nightLighting: Warm-white facade floodlighting, a warm foyer glow and lit poster panels at the entrance (estimated). The roof stays dark.
spots.infoTr: Süreyya İlmen Paşa'nın yaptırdığı, mimar Kegam Kavafyan'ın tasarladığı bina 1927'de Anadolu Yakası'nın ilk operet ve müzikli tiyatro sahnesi olarak açıldı. 1930'dan itibaren uzun yıllar sinema olarak kullanıldı, 2007'deki restorasyonla opera ve bale sahnesine dönüştü.
spots.correction: Priority lowered from must to should. From the air it is an ordinary flat roof in a street wall; it is recognisable only at street level, from its facade.
spots.overlaps: None in landmarks.ts. The small Kadıköy Sineması (OSM node 2446513062) is immediately north. Tier 1 must not place a generic block on this footprint.

spots.name: Aya Triada Rum Ortodoks Kilisesi (Kadıköy)
spots.coordSource: OSM way/237058780 (building=church), area centroid, re-fetched (0.2 m); walled garden OSM way/235253300 (56 x 38 m, 1,956 m², centroid 40.98618, 29.02750)
spots.dimensions: OSM church footprint 35.9 x 22.0 m (615 m²); MİMDAP gives 800 m² of building on a 3,000 m² plot. The long axis runs 110/290°. West end: a full-width block of about 19-20 m, with an 8 m wide porch projecting about 5 m. The transept gives the 22 m width, and the apse projects about 1.6 m at the east end, towards Bahariye. Heights are unpublished: dome top estimated at about 25-28 m and bell towers at about 22-28 m. The researchers disagree on which is taller; verify with a photo.
spots.look: Neo-Byzantine church in dressed cut stone on a closed Greek-cross plan. A high drum dome sits on four thick piers, buttressed by half-domes, so it reads as a cross from above. Two bell towers with round-arched openings stand at the corners; the footprint suggests the west corners, flanking the narthex and porch. The apse faces the liturgical east, towards General Asım Gündüz Cd (Bahariye), about 14 m away; the west entrance faces Hacı Şükrü Sk. A low wall with iron railings surrounds the garden, where Metropolitan Yermanos is buried. Stone colour not stated: use light beige-grey with grey metal-clad dome and belfry caps. The T3 tram passes at the Kilise stop, just SE.
spots.nightLighting: Not documented. Suggest a soft warm wash on the towers and the dome drum, with a dark courtyard.
spots.infoTr: Mimarları G. Zahariadis ve B. Makropoulos olan, 1887'de başlanıp 1902'de açılan Rum Ortodoks kilisesi; kapalı Yunan haçı planı, yüksek kasnaklı kubbesi ve iki çan kulesiyle Bahariye'nin silüetinde öne çıkar. Bahçesinde Kadıköy Metropoliti Yermanos gömülüdür.
spots.correction: Merged the duplicates from researchers 1 and 2. Researcher 1 put the towered entrance facade on General Asım Gündüz Cd, which is wrong: that street runs along the EAST (apse) end, as MİMDAP and the OSM geometry show. The entrance faces Hacı Şükrü Sk at 290°, as researcher 2 said. Height estimates conflict and are flagged.

spots.name: Moda Burnu, Moda Parkı ve Çay Bahçesi
spots.coordSource: Between OSM way/1202390879 (Moda Parkı, centroid 40.98091, 29.02122; 12 m away) and way/1451594477 (Moda Çay Bahçesi, centroid 40.98067, 29.02094), both re-fetched. The coastal fill park is OSM way/583794968 'Moda Sahil Park' (21,187 m²). No natural=cape node in OSM.
spots.dimensions: Moda Parkı: 4,141 m², about 102 x 52 m, on the bluff. Moda Çay Bahçesi: 3,771 m², a strip of about 199 x 45 m on the western slope. Coastal fill park: 21,187 m², a band of about 470 m wrapping the headland. Bluff top about 15-25 m above sea (estimated). Moda Deniz Kulübü is OSM way/235253303 at the tip (node 40.97959, 29.02104). The western walkway (OSM 'Moda Sahil Yürüme Yolu', way/689645023, 716 m) reaches the tip at 40.97933, 29.02141.
spots.look: The southern tip of the Kadıköy peninsula. On top: a wooded, hedged plateau (Moda Parkı, with a dog park). On the western slope: the terraced Moda Çay Bahçesi, with wooden tables and stools under shade trees, looking west. A green slope runs down to the 1990s fill: lawns, a paved walkway plus a bike lane, and a large riprap edge where crowds sit at sunset. At the tip are the Moda Deniz Kulübü buildings, small boat piers and moored yachts. Views: the Historic Peninsula to the NW, and the Princes' Islands and Fenerbahçe to the SE.
spots.nightLighting: Warm park lamps along the walkway, string lights in the tea garden, and lights on the club and moored boats. The lawns and slope stay dark.
spots.infoTr: Kadıköy'ün Marmara'ya uzanan burnu; tepedeki Moda Parkı ve çay bahçesinden Tarihi Yarımada ve Adalar görülür. Burnun ucundaki Moda Deniz Kulübü 1935'te kuruldu, çevresindeki sahil parkı 1990'larda deniz doldurularak yapıldı.
spots.overlaps: None. The coastline shape is tier 1; this spot is only the hero dressing (tree canopy, tea-garden terraces, riprap, the club).

spots.name: Fenerbahçe Parkı
spots.coordSource: OSM way/235392135 (leisure=park), area centroid, re-fetched (0.3 m)
spots.dimensions: 57,703 m² (OSM), about 331 m N-S x 253 m E-W. Extents: lat 40.96640-40.96921, lon 29.03290-29.03620. On the NE side a narrow water channel of about 90 x 12 m (OSM natural=water way 469996535) cuts it off; some sources call the park an island joined by a bridge. To the east is Fenerbahçe Orduevi, a non-public military social campus of about 188,000 m² (OSM way 167953312). Low ground, about 2-6 m above sea (estimated).
spots.look: A flat green headland pointing SSW into the Marmara. Large lawns under mature trees: plane trees and cypresses are documented; stone pines and Canary palms are likely (verify). A rocky, boulder-armoured shore with concrete stairs to the sea. Several cafés and tea gardens in low pavilions. Two çeşmes from 1967 (the larger has a hewn-stone roof and a marble mirror stone). The small Ottoman Fener Köşkü Hamamı (restored 2024). The Çelik Gülersoy monument (2003; OSM node 11113858505). The lighthouse is on the west rim. North side: club grounds facing the marina basin (Galatasaray Kalamış, İstanbul Yelken Kulübü, Kalamış Yelken Kulübü, the Fenerbahçe swimming branch), with dinghy parks and outdoor pools.
spots.nightLighting: Warm lamp posts on the paths and café glow; lawns dark, with tree silhouettes against the water. The lighthouse (white Fl(2) 12 s) sits on the west rim.
spots.infoTr: Bizans döneminde Justinianus'un yazlık sarayının bahçeleri olan burun, Osmanlı'da Kanuni Sultan Süleyman'ın sık uğradığı 'Fener Bahçesi' oldu. Bugünkü park düzeni 1990'da Çelik Gülersoy'un girişimiyle yapıldı.
spots.correction: Priority lowered from must to should: the recognisable air feature is the headland shape (tier 1) plus the lighthouse (its own 'must'), and the park needs only dressing. Info text rewritten. The claim that Kanuni had a köşk there is not in the source read; the source says Justinian built a summer palace and Kanuni visited the site regularly.
spots.overlaps: The repo landuse.ts entry 'Fenerbahçe Parkı' (ll [40.9625,29.0345, 40.9655,29.0405, 40.9705,29.0385, 40.9685,29.0325]) has its centre about 210 m SE of the real park. Its southern part lies in the sea (the real south shore is at 40.9664) and it covers Fenerbahçe Orduevi. Replace it with the OSM way 235392135 outline.

spots.name: Kadıköy Şehremaneti Binası (TESAK)
spots.coordSource: OSM way/236166952 'Kadıköy Şehremaneti' (historic=building, inscription 'Şehremaneti Kadıköy Dairesi'), centroid, re-fetched (0.4 m)
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 25.5 x 23.0 m (462 m²), long axis 65/245°. It reads as two storeys but has a basement, ground floor and upper floor (MİMDAP). Estimated height 11-12 m. Front facade faces NW (MİMDAP).
spots.look: Neo-classical / First National Architecture civic building by Yervant Terziyan, 1912-14, one of the first buildings on the reclaimed pier square. Arched windows and doors and tile panels on the facade. Three entrances: front, rear and the Yeldeğirmeni side. A balcony was used for rallies in 1919. It completes the square's national-architecture trio with the 1926 pier and the 1927 market hall. Restored in 2013; the TESAK library since 15 Mar 2014.
spots.nightLighting: Assumed: warm facade uplight and lit library windows.
spots.infoTr: Deniz doldurularak açılan iskele meydanında Yervant Terziyan'ın tasarladığı, 1912–1914'te yapılan kemerli ve çinili eski Kadıköy Şehremaneti binası; uzun yıllar belediye ve kaymakamlık olarak kullanıldı. 2014'ten beri Tarih Edebiyat Sanat Kütüphanesi (TESAK) olarak hizmet veriyor.
spots.overlaps: None in landmarks.ts. It stands about 110 m SW of the historic pier on Rıhtım Meydanı.

spots.name: Osmanağa Camii
spots.coordSource: OSM way/102190099 'Osman Ağa Cami' (building=mosque), centroid, re-fetched (0.3 m)
spots.dimensions: OSM footprint 23.1 x 16.1 m (369 m²), a clean rectangle with its long axis at 130/310°. headingDeg follows the repo's qibla-axis convention; the entrance and portico face NW (310°). No published heights: walls estimated at about 9-10 m, roof ridge about 13 m, minaret about 25-28 m.
spots.look: No dome. A rectangular prayer hall with walls of three brick courses to one cut-stone course, giving red-brown and cream bands. Timber roof structure; the interior ceiling is flat wood. 40 windows: rectangular below, pointed-arch above. The last-congregation portico was added later and enclosed. A small single-balcony minaret. The courtyard has a çeşme, two gates (street side and qibla side) and a large plane tree planted in 1880, whose canopy is a visual cue from above. It sits on Söğütlüçeşme Cd at the northern market edge, beside the Çarşı tram stop.
spots.nightLighting: Assumed: modest warm floodlight on the minaret and a lit balcony ring, glowing windows at prayer times, and a street-lit plane-tree courtyard.
spots.infoTr: I. Ahmed'in Babüssaade ağası Osman Ağa'nın 1612'de yaptırdığı cami, 1878'deki büyük Kadıköy yangınında yandıktan sonra yeniden yapıldı. Kubbesi yoktur; üç sıra tuğla ile bir sıra kesme taştan örülen duvarları ahşap çatıyla örtülüdür, avlusunda 1880'de dikilmiş bir çınar vardır.
spots.correction: Priority lowered from should to nice: from the air it is a small tiled roof with a minaret, with no dome. The info text no longer says 'rebuilt the same year', which is unconfirmed. Year set to the founding date (1612) instead of 1878.

spots.name: Surp Takavor Ermeni Kilisesi
spots.coordSource: OSM way/694715147 (church body, building=yes) centroid, re-fetched (0.4 m); enclosure OSM way/235498056 (centroid 40.98988, 29.02443); glazed narthex OSM way/694715148
spots.dimensions: Church body 18.3 x 18.2 m (271 m², cross-shaped outline, axes 30/120°). Glazed narthex about 14 x 5 m on the NE side. Walled enclosure 28.0 x 25.5 m (653 m²). Estimated dome top about 18-20 m and bell tower about 15-18 m.
spots.look: Closed-cross plan, unlike classical Armenian churches. A high-drum dome covers the centre and tiled roofs cover the cross arms. Only the entrance facade is in dressed stone; the rest is plain. A small Gothic-style bell tower, rebuilt in 2007, is the second landmark element. A timber roof with glass walls encloses the entrance area. It sits embedded in the dense market block on Muvakkithane Cd, with the benefactor Murat Garabetyan and his wife buried in the courtyard. Repaired in 1936, 1978 and 2011. The Kadıköy Timsah statue (OSM node 9963867334) stands about 25 m NW.
spots.nightLighting: Not documented. Suggest a lit dome drum, warm windows and a small uplight on the bell tower, set in a bright market street.
spots.infoTr: Kayıtlarda ilk kez 1722'de anılan Ermeni kilisesi, 19. yüzyıldaki deprem ve yangın hasarlarının ardından kâgir olarak yeniden yapılıp 1858'de Surp Takavor ('Kutsal Kral') adıyla açıldı. Yüksek kasnaklı kubbesi ve 2007'de yeniden yapılan Gotik üsluplu çan kulesiyle çarşının ortasında yükselir.
spots.correction: Info text fixed. The cause of the rebuild is disputed: en.wiki cites earthquake damage around 1840, tarihi.ist a fire in Aug 1855. Both are now covered as '19. yüzyıldaki deprem ve yangın hasarları', and 'kökleri 18. yüzyıla' is replaced with the documented 1722 first mention. Heading 30 (NE entrance) is inferred from the narthex position and Muvakkithane Cd, not from a source.

spots.name: Bahariye Caddesi (General Asım Gündüz Caddesi)
spots.coordSource: Midpoint by length of the pedestrian OSM ways 236495375, 1546691343, 678909314, 695663505 and 621990109 'General Asım Gündüz Caddesi' (723 m total), re-fetched and re-computed
spots.dimensions: Pedestrian section 723 m (OSM, re-computed) from Altıyol (40.99045, 29.02908) to the Hasırcıbaşı junction (40.98435, 29.02718), where it becomes an ordinary street. The official street continues to Dr. Esat Işık Cd. About 10-14 m between facades (estimated). Axis about 193°/13°.
spots.look: A pedestrian street carrying the single metre-gauge T3 track. Continuous 4-8-storey apartments from the early 20th century to the 1980s. Ground floors hold shops, cafés and venues: Süreyya Operası, Moda Sahnesi (40.98701, 29.02864), Baba Sahne (40.98733, 29.02792), Kadıköy Sineması, and Ak'la Kara (40.98534, 29.02754). Aya Triada sits just off it. Concrete-sett paving (colour estimated), some street trees and café tables.
spots.nightLighting: Dense shopfront and sign lighting, street lamps and warm tram interiors; one of Kadıköy's brightest streets at night.
spots.infoTr: Resmî adı General Asım Gündüz Caddesi olan Bahariye, Altıyol'dan Moda yönüne uzanır ve 1992'de taşıt trafiğine kapatıldı. Süreyya Operası, tiyatroları ve ortasından geçen nostaljik tramvayla Kadıköy'ün kültür aksıdır.
spots.correction: Year changed from 1993 to 1992. Gazete Kadıköy (2017) says the street was closed to traffic 25 years earlier, and the Kadıköy Ansiklopedisi says 1992; the kaymakamlık's 1993 is noted as the minority date.
spots.overlaps: Mostly a tier-2 street; this entry mainly serves the discovery card.

spots.name: Yoğurtçu Parkı
spots.coordSource: OSM way/66320567 (leisure=park), centroid, re-fetched (0.3 m); Yoğurtçu Çeşmesi OSM node/9964513645 at 40.98363, 29.03324
spots.dimensions: 23,193 m²: a strip of about 395 m N-S x 40-70 m (OSM). Extents: lat 40.98353-40.98706, lon 29.03321-29.03421. It lies on the west bank of the canalised Kurbağalıdere, about 70 m wide here (OSM water way 85644756). A concrete quay wall was built along the creek from 1923.
spots.look: A linear, tree-shaded park between Kuşdili/Hasırcıbaşı streets and the concrete-walled creek. It holds paths, tea gardens, basketball and tennis courts, playgrounds and fitness areas; tree species are unverified. Yoğurtçu Çeşmesi (early 1800s) is at the south end. Statues S to N: Fikret Mualla, an Atatürk bust, Yunus Emre, Lefter Küçükandonyadis, Süreyya İlmen, Can Bartu and a mermaid. The Dereağzı training ground with 4 lattice floodlight towers faces it across the creek.
spots.nightLighting: Warm park and tea-garden lamps reflected in the creek; the Dereağzı floodlights across the water during training.
spots.infoTr: Kurbağalıdere kıyısındaki bataklık, Süreyya İlmen'in öncülüğünde 1923'ten itibaren kurutulup düzenlendi ve park 1925'te açıldı. Adını, 1800'lerin başında yoğurtçu esnafının yaptırdığı söylenen Yoğurtçu Çeşmesi'nden alır.
spots.correction: Priority lowered from should to nice: from the air it is a tree strip already covered by tier-1 land use. The info text now includes the 1923 start of the works.

spots.name: Kuşdili Çayırı
spots.coordSource: No named OSM feature. The centre is the area-weighted mean of three OSM polygons, re-fetched and re-computed: way/158447580 'İspark Eski Salı Pazarı Otoparkı' (16,548 m², 40.99055, 29.03358), way/1155670402 (landuse=construction, 14,606 m², 40.99001, 29.03447) and way/1099813874 (natural=wood, 9,211 m², 40.98923, 29.03519).
spots.dimensions: About 43,300 m² (İBB yesil.istanbul), about 290 x 170 m. The long axis runs NE-SW between Kuşdili Cd (W) and Kurbağalıdere (E), from the stadium and Fenerium (S) to Söğütlüçeşme (N).
spots.look: Not a meadow today. It is a flat asphalt İSPARK surface car park (the old Salı Pazarı ground), a walled construction/landscaping site and a strip of trees and grass along the concrete-walled creek, with the Söğütlüçeşme metrobüs and Marmaray viaducts rising to the NE. In 2022 İBB dropped a multi-storey car-park plan in favour of a 'meadow' green area; the application project is still in progress. Best handled as tier-1 ground cover, with an optional future meadow variant.
spots.nightLighting: Car-park light poles; otherwise dark, next to the brightly lit stadium on match nights.
spots.infoTr: Kurbağalıdere kıyısındaki tarihi çayır Osmanlı döneminden beri mesire yeriydi; 20. yüzyılın başında yazlık sinemalara ve gazinolara, sonraki yıllarda Salı Pazarı'na ev sahipliği yaptı. Bugün büyük bölümü otopark ve şantiye; İBB alanı yeniden çayır olarak düzenlemeyi planlıyor.
spots.correction: The coordinate is unchanged (reproduced exactly). The spot is 'unverified' only because OSM has no feature named Kuşdili Çayırı. The info text now separates the early-20th-century uses from the later Salı Pazarı.

spots.name: Kalamış Parkı (Kalamış Atatürk Parkı)
spots.coordSource: OSM way/51774213 (leisure=park), centroid, re-fetched (0.5 m)
spots.dimensions: 41,600 m² (OSM), about 395 m NW-SE x 143 m. Extents: lat 40.97849-40.98129, lon 29.03622-29.04005. Hürriyet's 3,400 m² conflicts with OSM; use OSM. The Kadıköy Belediyesi Gençlik Merkezi green (about 18,000 m², OSM way 236790712) adjoins it to the NW.
spots.look: A lawn sloping SW with scattered mature trees, ending at the seafront promenade on Münir Nurettin Selçuk Cd and facing the Kalamış marina basin. It contains a skatepark (about 37 x 22 m, 40.97981, 29.03761), basketball and volleyball courts, a dog park, a playground and a running track, plus statues of Fazıl Hüsnü Dağlarca and Aslı Nemutlu. The Sadun Boro statue is just SE (40.97662, 29.04113).
spots.nightLighting: Path lamps and lit courts, with the marina's pontoon and mast lights in front.
spots.infoTr: Kalamış Koyu'na bakan, Münir Nurettin Selçuk Caddesi boyunca uzanan eğimli çimenlik park; kaykay pisti, spor sahaları ve kıyı yürüyüş yoluyla semtin buluşma yerlerinden biridir.

tierNotes:
VERIFICATION METHOD
- Three Overpass requests, spaced apart (dataset 2026-09-22), fetched every cited way and node.
- Centroids and minimum-area rectangles were recomputed locally. All hero coordinates are within 1 m of the OSM feature, except the composite spots (Moda Burnu: 12 m from the Moda Parkı centroid; Kuşdili: no named feature).
- tr.wikipedia.org was not reachable from this environment, so Turkish facts were cross-checked on en.wikipedia, MİMDAP, tarihi.ist, Kültür Envanteri, KEGM, Gazete Kadıköy, Hürriyet, indigodergisi, emlaknews and istanbulunsirlari.
- No repo files were touched.

REPO ISSUES (read-only findings)
1) places.ts pier 'kadikoy' has two berths:
   - [40.99296, 29.02313] = the new Eminönü–Karaköy pier (OSM way/560203763).
   - [40.99182, 29.02155] = the 1926 historic pier (way/102190096).
   - pier-builder.ts draws the same cream 2-storey gable hall with a clock tower at both. No source mentions a clock tower on either real building.
   - The new pier is an 82 x 18 m bar perpendicular to the quay; the historic one is a 37 x 17 m block parallel to it.
   - Keep the builder's platform, fenders and lamps, and skip its hall where a hero model exists.
2) 'kadikoy-ido' (40.99124, 29.0181) is the modern İDO terminal and needs no hero model.
   - The small Turyol pontoons (OSM way/236642399 at 40.99129, 29.02051; way/226127060 at 40.99377, 29.02392) can use the 'small' style.
3) Moda has no pier in places.ts, although Moda İskelesi is served by the Bostancı–Moda–Karaköy–Kabataş line (since 1 Jan 2024).
4) The landuse.ts 'Fenerbahçe Parkı' polygon is centred about 210 m SE of the real park. It is partly in the sea and covers Fenerbahçe Orduevi. Replace it with OSM way 235392135 (lat 40.96640-40.96921, lon 29.03290-29.03620).
5) coastline.ts BREAKWATERS lists only the two Haydarpaşa moles. The Kalamış and Fenerbahçe breakwaters (20-35 m wide) are only part of the OSM coastline (way 235683666; no man_made=breakwater ways) and risk being stripped. Add centerlines:
   - Fenerbahçe west mole: about 40.97102, 29.03400 → 40.97402, 29.03445.
   - Kalamış west mole: about 40.9742, 29.0360 → 40.97705, 29.03547.
   - Kalamış north mole: about 40.9779, 29.0382 → 40.97705, 29.03638.
   - Cross mole at lat about 40.9741, lon 29.0353 → 29.0371.
6) OSM has a stray man_made=lighthouse (way 236464877, 4 x 4 m) at 40.98917, 29.03630 near Söğütlüçeşme. Do not auto-spawn a lighthouse there.
7) landmarks.ts haydarpasa-gari (40.9961, 29.01851) lies about 400-560 m NE of the piers; no conflict.

RIHTIM (PIER) SQUARE, tier 1/2
- Rıhtım Meydanı (OSM node 6458152384, 40.99125, 29.02160) is a large, loosely defined paved and asphalt plaza. It runs from the İDO terminal to the new pier, bordered by the historic pier, Şehremaneti, İskele Camii and Haldun Taner.
- It is reclaimed land from the 1900s. It holds İETT bus platforms with long flat canopies and the T3 terminus loop.
- Rıhtım Cd continues NE as a straight quay with a stone edge and Canary palms to Haydarpaşa (about 500 m).
- Başöğretmen Atatürk Anıtı: Haluk Tezonar, 1989; OSM way/236509904, 15 m plinth area, centroid 40.99158, 29.02266. Discovery point at most.
- Kadıköy Rıhtım Camii is under construction SW of the İDO terminal (OSM way/159256124, about 40.98992, 29.01860).
  - The surface car park closed 17 Mar 2026; foundation work was planned for May 2026, with a 3-year target.
  - Bianet gives 33,559 m² and capacity for 20,000. Minaret and dome figures come from an unopened search summary.
  - Model at most a fenced site with tower cranes.

KADIKÖY MARKET (Tarihi Çarşı), tier 2
- A pedestrian grid of about 40.9885-40.9912 N, 29.0225-29.0280 E, between Söğütlüçeşme Cd (N), Rıhtım/Albay Faik Sözdener Cd (W), Mühürdar/Moda Cd (S) and Altıyol (E).
- Streets:
  - Güneşlibahçe Sk: about 280 m; fish, pickles, deli, produce.
  - Serasker Cd: about 370 m.
  - Muvakkithane Cd: about 230 m; Surp Takavor.
  - Yasa Cd and Tavus Sk: İskele Camii gates.
  - Also Mühürdar Cd, Başçavuş Sk, Moda Cd, Dumlupınar, Pavlonya, Kırtasiyeci and Bekçi Sk.
- Lanes are 4-8 m wide, lined with continuous 3-6-storey late-Ottoman and 20th-century blocks, 100% shops on the ground floor.
- Fishmongers: tilted ice-bed counters under red and orange lamps, blue and white crates, hanging awnings. Greengrocers spill produce into the lane.
- At night the lanes glow densely with shopfronts and meyhane tables.
- Kadıköy Timsah statue (2007, OSM node 9963867334, 40.99008, 29.02435) next to Surp Takavor; micro discovery point.
- Also in the market: Aya Efimia church (way/179197257); Surp Levon (way/236642397) and the Rum Metropolitliği (way/235253307) near Altıyol.

T3 KADIKÖY–MODA NOSTALGIC TRAM (OSM relation/2409338)
- Clockwise single-track loop, 2.6 km, 1000 mm gauge, overhead wire, opened 1 Nov 2003.
- en.wiki says 10 stations. OSM stop nodes:
  - Kadıköy İDO-Metro 40.98998, 29.02212
  - İskele Cami 40.99065, 29.02318
  - Çarşı 40.99115, 29.02552
  - Altıyol 40.98938, 29.02884
  - Bahariye 40.98767, 29.02855
  - Kilise 40.98598, 29.02792
  - Moda İlkokulu 40.98409, 29.02670
  - Moda Caddesi 40.98406, 29.02438
  - Rıza Paşa 40.98467, 29.02272
  - Mühürdar 40.98549, 29.02111
  - Damga Sokak 40.98885, 29.02056
- Route: square → Söğütlüçeşme Cd → Altıyol → Bahariye → Moda Cd → Mühürdar Cd → Damga Sk → square.
- Stops are street level with no shelters. About 6 trams run every ~10 min; a round trip takes ~20 min.
- Vehicles: two-axle ex-East-German trams. en.wiki lists Gotha T57 (İstanbul 202, 204-207) and Rekowagen (201, 203), built 1958-75, from Jena and Schöneiche.
  - Metro İstanbul's 'Tatra GT6' does not match that list; GT6 is an articulated type, so trust the en.wiki fleet list.
  - Livery is unconfirmed: red body with a cream window band is from memory. Verify.
- A 2026 İBB plan reroutes the Damga Sk–Çarşı section. A proposed Üsküdar–Kadıköy–Cevizli tram (OSM railway=proposed) passes Altıyol.

BAHARIYE, tier 2
- Pedestrian spine 723 m long at a bearing of about 193°. Continuous 4-8-storey rows with bright shop and theatre signs, some street trees, café tables and the rail down the middle.
- Rexx Sineması (OSM way/478608919, 40.98750, 29.02627; 3 levels, 12.75 m) closed in 2020 and was approved for demolition in Aug 2024. It is listed as demolished in 2025, to be rebuilt as a cultural complex. Use a construction site or a generic block, not a hero.
- Saint Joseph Lycée campus (about 40.9822, 29.0280): large 19th-century school blocks; possible future candidate.

YELDEĞIRMENI MURALS, tier 2 decals
- Mural İstanbul festival since 2012: about 30 murals on blind side firewalls of 4-7-storey blocks, typically 8-12 m wide and 12-20 m tall.
- Zone: lat 40.9920-40.9985, lon 29.0255-29.0310; Karakolhane Cd is the spine.
- Known walls (approximate coordinates):
  - Pixel Pancho 'Bambino' (2012), Misak-ı Milli × Nüzhet Efendi, 40.99299, 29.02649.
  - Dome 'Ark' (2012), black and white, about 40.9930, 29.0281.
